# Wesley Mendes

> Tech Lead at Liquid AI. I build agentic AI systems that run in production.

## Selected work

- [Agentic WhatsApp assistant](https://wesleymendes.vercel.app/#work): tool-calling converse-loop on Amazon Bedrock, with a RAG sub-agent, deterministic gates and guardrails enforced in code.
- [Multi-agent development harness](https://wesleymendes.vercel.app/#work): planner, implementer, reviewer and publisher agents dispatched over a dependency graph.
- [Agentic operations CRM](https://wesleymendes.vercel.app/#work): hexagonal FastAPI service and React front end where agents work the pipeline alongside analysts.
- [AI legal SaaS](https://wesleymendes.vercel.app/#work): multi-tenant product built solo, with Stripe billing and AI cost governance.
